_comment: Scripted human reviewer decisions used by Stage 3/4 and FINAL so the pause/resume cycle is deterministic. In production these arrive from a review UI, one at a time, hours later.

PAY-1004.reason: Call-back to the phone number on file did not confirm the new bank details; ask supplier to re-submit via the portal.

PAY-1005.reason: Only 31,500 received. Return to AP to request a revised invoice for delivered quantity.

PAY-1006.reason: Receipt GR-55199 located in warehouse system (late scan); delivery confirmed by dock supervisor.

PAY-1008.reason: CFO office confirms no such request was made; potential social-engineering attempt reported to security.

PAY-1009.reason: Invoice bank account does not match vendor master and vendor is 34 days old; fraud review opened.

PAY-1010.reason: Onboarding documents and two trade references verified; first payment approved.

PAY-1011.reason: Amount above J. Okafor's 50k limit; reviewer limit is 100k; matched evidence confirmed.
